E0301

`impl Int.Mul` needs a user-defined type

What

`impl Int.Mul` needs a user-defined type

Why

`Int` is built in, and an `impl` only extends a struct, enum, or distinct type declared by your program; an undeclared name reports the same code.

Fix

Call a named method, or implement `Mul` on a struct or distinct type of your own (an operator hook on `Int` belongs to the package that declares the other operand type).

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning E0301: tests/ui/computed_alias_bound_is_not_a_trait.stderr.

Error [jet.ImplOnBuiltinType]: The computed alias bound `Heap` is not a trait
  --> tests/ui/computed_alias_bound_is_not_a_trait.jet:7:18
    |
  7 | Storage<N: Int>: Heap #run { if N <= 16 -> Heap else -> Heap }
    |                  ^^^^
 Why: Every type a computed alias chooses implements its bound, a trait
 Fix: Write a trait between `:` and `#run`
